source.title: Applications for World Championship 2019
source.content:
The WCA Board of Directors are accepting applications for WCA World Championship 2019.

Please discuss with the Delegates in your country whether this is something you are willing and able to pursue. Bear in mind that organizing a competition of this size takes a significant amount of time and effort before and during the competition.

If you are interested, send your application documents privately to [albertopdrf.wca@gmail.com](mailto:albertopdrf.wca@gmail.com) **before 23:59 UTC of July 15th, 2018**. **Documents must be sent in PDF format in two versions:** one full version with all the details for the application, and another version with sensitive details - if any - removed to make public.
<!-- break -->
Please include in your application documents at least the following information:

When would you like to hold WC 2019?
1a. Possible dates
1b. Number of days of the competition.
1c. Overlap with international holiday periods of schools.

Where would you like to hold WC 2019 in your country?
2a. City should be interesting to visit for foreigners with opportunities for sightseeing.
2b. Ease of international, national, and local travel.
2c. Availability of hotels/apartments with different price categories.
2d. Venue, venue size, and venue setup (stage, audience, tables to practice, side rooms).
2e. Technology available like internet, video streaming, lighting, sound equipment.
2f. Number of competitors and spectators that can be hosted.

What would the organization team and staff look like?
3a. Core team members.
3b. Experience of the core team.
3c. Involvement of other parties.
3d. Quantity and quality of local volunteers (guideline is 20% of competitors should staff).
3e. Required support by foreign Delegates.

What would be the overall budget for the competition?
4a. Cost (venue, venue services, stage, equipment, decorations, website, badges/lanyards/giftpacks, prizes).
4b. Income (registration fees, sponsoring, local government).

Here is an example document with a non-exhaustive list of topics that need to be arranged and budgeted for a large competition: [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8)

Once the application period is over, the WCA Board of Directors will interview applicants, consult other WCA Staff members, and vote in order to decide where the WCA World Championship 2019 will take place. If any Director will be involved in a team that sends in an application, he will be replaced in the selection process by another person (for example a Senior Delegate or a Committee/Team Leader).

We are looking for a competition that can reinforce our concept of large WCA competitions, boost the professionalization of our organization, and is able to give the competitors the best possible experience and the world the best possible show.

translation.title: 2019 年 WCA 世锦赛申办通知
translation.content:
WCA 董事会现接受 2019 年 WCA 世锦赛的申办申请。

请与你所在国家的代表讨论，确认是否有意愿、有能力申办。请注意，举办这一规模的比赛，在赛前和比赛期间都需要投入大量时间与精力。

有意申办者，请于 **2018 年 7 月 15 日 23:59 UTC 前**，私下将申请材料发送至 [albertopdrf.wca@gmail.com](mailto:albertopdrf.wca@gmail.com)。**材料须以 PDF 格式提交两个版本：**一份包含所有申办细节的完整版，以及一份删去敏感内容（如有）、可供公开的版本。

申请材料至少应包含以下信息：

### 希望何时举办 2019 年世锦赛？

1a. 可选日期。
1b. 比赛天数。
1c. 与世界各地学校假期的重合情况。

### 希望在本国哪个地方举办 2019 年世锦赛？

2a. 城市对外国游客的吸引力，以及可供游览的景点。
2b. 国际、国内及本地交通的便利程度。
2c. 不同价位的酒店或公寓供应情况。
2d. 场馆、面积及布置，包括舞台、观众席、练习桌和附属房间。
2e. 可用技术设施，包括网络、视频直播、灯光和音响。
2f. 可容纳的选手与观众人数。

### 主办团队和工作人员如何组成？

3a. 核心团队成员。
3b. 核心团队的经验。
3c. 其他参与方。
3d. 本地志愿者的人数和能力；建议约 20% 的选手担任工作人员。
3e. 需要外国代表提供哪些支持。

### 比赛总预算是多少？

4a. 支出：场租、场馆服务、舞台、设备、装饰、网站、胸牌、挂绳、礼包和奖品等。
4b. 收入：报名费、赞助和地方政府支持等。

下面这份示例表格列出了大型比赛需要安排和编入预算的部分事项，但并非完整清单：[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1w6uxOHrr40of1R4-NjU1vy7fVJXRHiRZBn53Hc-IOk8)

申请期结束后，WCA 董事会将与申办方面谈，征询其他 WCA 工作人员的意见，并通过投票决定 2019 WCA 世锦赛的举办地点。如有董事参与某个申办团队，该董事在选拔流程中的职责将由其他人代替，例如高级代表或委员会、团队负责人。

我们希望这场比赛能够体现 WCA 对大型赛事的理念，进一步提高协会的专业水平，为选手提供尽可能好的参赛体验，也为全世界呈现精彩的比赛。
